newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM SETS CARGO FUEL SURCHARGE AT DFL 0.20.
newsitem.headline: KLM SETS CARGO FUEL SURCHARGE AT DFL 0.20.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday its Cargo division would be levying a fuel surcharge on shipments worldwide of 20 guilder cents per kilogram.
"The decision is the result of the steep rise in aircraft fuel prices," KLM said in a statement.
It said the levy of 0.20 guilders or local currency equivalent would take effect from Friday November 1.
"The levy will apply to all air waybills issued by KLM Cargo and will be noted on the air waybills separately in the due carrier box," it said.
The airline said it would adjust the surcharge should this be justified by further developments in aircraft fuel prices.
KLM said it would introduce a cargo surcharge when it announced a fuel levy on passenger fares last week.
